purpose: 用户提供了 YOPO 参考[17] 的合法全文副本。本文件记录该副本的身份核对结果与归档位置，供选项 A（补齐 300 个 mppi_reference17 槽位）使用。

identity_check.title: Flight With Limited Field of View: A Parallel and Gradient-Free Strategy for Micro Aerial Vehicle
identity_check.recorded_reference_verbatim: [17] H. Lu, Q. Zong, S. Lai, B. Tian, and L. Xie, “Flight with limited field of view: A parallel and gradient-free strategy for micro aerial vehicle,” IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, vol. 69, no. 9, pp. 9258–9267, 2021.

fidelity_findings_from_the_paper_text.terminology: The paper itself never uses the strings 'MPPI' or 'Model Predictive Path Integral' or 'Hybrid A*'. It formulates a stochastic optimal control / sampling-based MPC problem (KL-divergence minimization with importance-sampling weights, citing [8],[9],[10]) and solves it gradient-free in parallel on a GPU. This is the MPPI family, which is why YOPO refers to it as 'MPPI Planner with Hybrid A* [17]'.
fidelity_findings_from_the_paper_text.global_planner_in_paper: RRT* over the currently perceived map at low frequency; a local goal Gl is chosen from the global path within the sensor range ds (or within threshold dt); an emergency policy replans when the path becomes infeasible. YOPO's one-line 'Hybrid A* front end' is therefore a shorthand that does not match the paper's own front end.

local_planner_parameters.update_time: 20.69 ms average on Jetson Xavier NX, 8.10 ms on a laptop
local_planner_parameters.platform: NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX (384 CUDA cores), Intel RealSense D455 (87 deg x 58 deg FOV, ~10 m range), Pixhawk autopilot, geometric controller, Tube-MPC robustness framework
local_planner_parameters.cost_terms: dynamic/motion cost, collision cost, limited-FOV soft constraints (yaw alignment c_psi, out-of-FOV penalty c_FOVh, level-flight c_FOVv), terminal cost; guiding-path selection weights lambda_s (motion), lambda_p (path length), lambda_m (memory/successive selection)

fidelity_findings_from_the_paper_text.implication_for_reproduction: 参考[17] 的可复现路径已由'无源码不可做'变为'可按论文参数实现'：局部规划器 = 2560 采样 / 3.5 s 时域 / 10 Hz 的 sampling-based MPC（MPPI 家族），前端 = RRT* 全局路径 + 局部目标选择。实现必须按论文而不是按 YOPO 的一句话转述（转述里的 'Hybrid A*' 与原文不符，需要在该基线的报告里显式记录）。
